name: Taofeek Olalekan
headline: Senior HPC & AI Infrastructure Engineer
summary: I work on AI/ML infrastructure at Thoughtworks, contributing to sovereign AI cloud platforms at 10,000+ GPU scale. My focus is distributed inference, GPU systems and reliable production operations.
description: Taofeek Olalekan — Senior HPC & AI Infrastructure Engineer. Disaggregated LLM inference, GPU systems, Linux, networking and sovereign AI cloud platforms.
focus: LLM serving with NVIDIA Dynamo and SGLang: topology, KV capacity, scheduling and long-context workloads.
GPU infrastructure on Kubernetes: allocation, GPU/NIC affinity, NUMA placement and RDMA verification.
Network topology and communication: leaf–spine fabrics, collective efficiency and the interaction between GPU compute and storage.
Performance and evaluation: concurrency sweeps, TTFT, inter-token latency, throughput per GPU and agent benchmarks.
GitOps operations: reproducible deployments, observability, verification and recovery.
approach: I work across the stack, from Linux and network topology to Kubernetes and inference runtimes. When configuration alone cannot explain a problem, I follow it into the source code.
background: My background spans electronics, embedded systems, applied machine learning and cloud platforms. That progression shapes how I approach AI infrastructure: hardware, networking and software have to work together.
community: I also write and mentor. My community work has included AI Commons, the Facebook/Andela Build for SDG programme and teaching AI with Tech4her.
